name: Path in Sight
description:
Life is a bog that you keep sinking deeper and deeper into, until it swallows you.
<Hidden Tunnel> Toggles the standby/deployed status of Miner Guerrillas assembled here.
<Heavily Polluted Facility> Creates Toxic Pollution around it that prevents deployment and makes enemies invisible.
<Rock Wall> Units cannot be deployed on this tile.
